project.name: EIR :: policy
project.description:
Policy and rule-set resolution: which version is in force, who approved it, and what it resolves a fee code, a rate driver or a contract tier to. Framework-free, like the two modules below it — the root enforcer bans Spring, JPA, Hibernate and Jackson across every module, so configuration is read with plain Java rather than a binding library.
Depends on eir-calc rather than absorbing its routing package: eir-calc owns the routing DECISION (RoutingTable, EventRouter, RoutingDecision), this module owns which table version is in force on a date and who signed it off. Dependencies point inward, per 05 § 2.
